title: Built an open world driving game with some missions
author: aniketjatav
selftext:
I started building this as a demo for a threejs asset library which I released for free recently. Wanted to show the assets in action, so prompted Opus 5 to do it lol and it took off well on X. I kept building and evolving it. So far it has 3 main missions and 2 side quests. Will continue to work on this on and off. Maybe stretch to 10 missions.  
  
Here's the play link!  
[https://app.usecrayon.ai/play/54a355cc-d8e4-4d14-bab4-1b6db1618242](https://app.usecrayon.ai/play/54a355cc-d8e4-4d14-bab4-1b6db1618242)

  
*\*Full disclosure before you try the game above. I do own this platform as another project.*

comments.author: lordpoee
comments.body: Not bad, did you build the 3d objects? I'd love to see the workflow

replies.author: aniketjatav
replies.body:
Thanks! I can record a demo but at a high level I was art directing heavily, created an image for each asset (4 profile views) and then explained each asset in as much detail as I could haha and let Sol & Opus do the job. Sol did fine for most assets but failed at building vehicles where I had to get Opus involved.

I didnt use any loops, it was iterative process but at the end I had an asset pack of 60! Took a week I think lol.

Happy to DM more details when I am able to do a full demo.

comments.body: looks great man is it playable in browser?

replies.author: aniketjatav
replies.body: Thanks! Yes, playable on a desktop browser. Not phone ready yet. Added a playable link in the post description

replies.body: super nice dude, would love to have it on our gaming website so others can find it and play it too :D
